text: High school diploma or equivalent certificate, all high school courses and their transcripts or equivalent transcripts Certificate of English proficiencyCopy of passport If passport has been extended, passport extension page should be provided. If you are not in your country of origin at the time of registration, a valid visa from your current country of residence is required. Electronic passport size photographs Study plan The applicant undertaking Proof of financial guarantee or financial guarantee undertakingProof of no criminal record or undertaking of no criminal record Other application materials required by the school. Awards, certificates of honor, or other materials that students find helpful in their application. Those who have experience in China are required to provide all visa, residence permit, certificate of study or completion, transcript, temporary accommodation registration form and other documents
